about.title: Player Profile
about.description: I am a builder exploring the intersection of design, engineering, and artificial intelligence. This is my digital avatar.
about.objectivesP1: My primary focus right now is building autonomous systems that can reason, plan, and execute complex workflows. I believe the future of software is agentic, and I want to be at the forefront of this shift.
about.objectivesP2: When I'm not writing code, I'm usually reading about philosophy, playing indie games, or learning new visual design techniques.
